source: NBA 2026 Kia Shooting Stars rules (official PDF)
extraction: pdftotext -layout; the ordering table's green/red colouring on page 2 was read from a rendered image, not from the text layer

verified_facts.format: Four teams of 3 (2 NBA players + 1 NBA Legend), two-round timed competition
verified_facts.order: Locations 1 to 7 in order; each player shoots once at each of locations 1-6 in a pre-declared order; at location 7 players shoot in order as many times as the clock allows; a passer at the left wing feeds each shot; the team advances as a unit
verified_facts.advancement: Top 2 of 4 teams by round-1 points advance; lower round-1 team shoots first in the final; higher final score wins (round-1 scores do not carry)
verified_facts.first_round_tiebreaker: If a tie must be broken to decide the final teams, tied teams rerun with a 30-second limit; only that score counts
verified_facts.final_round_tiebreaker: If tied, teams compete again for the full 1:10; higher score wins
disqualification: all players do not make valid shot attempts from a shooting location
players advance to and shoot from locations out of order
verified_facts.out_of_order_shots: A shot out of the declared player order does not count (locations 1-6 shooter does not shoot again; at location 7 shots before the correct order is followed do not count); table on page 2 shows a shot counts when the player is in his declared slot

not_stated_in_source: what happens to a disqualified team's score or advancement
whether replay is used in specific cases beyond 'at the referee's discretion'
tie-handling beyond the two named tiebreakers (e.g. a tie for first when advancement is not at stake)

kalshi_side.rules_primary: If Team <name> wins the 2026 Pro Basketball All-Star Shooting Stars contest originally scheduled for February 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
kalshi_side.contract_terms_note: the Shooting Stars series points at the Rising Stars terms file; it was not readable from this environment (assets.kalshi.com returned a blocked response), so Kalshi-specific tie, disqualification, replay and cancellation handling is UNKNOWN
